spoken_script: New Zealand Proposes Social Media Ban for Under-16s. The New Zealand government has introduced the Online Safety (Minimum Age and Child Safety Risk Assessment) Bill, which would mandate age verification on high-risk platforms and impose penalties of up to 10% of global revenue for non-compliance. Why it matters: The bill represents a significant escalation in global regulatory efforts to restrict youth access to social media, with substantial financial implications for tech firms operating in the region.
